name: vesper-codex
description: Local-first, read-only Trading 212 portfolio intelligence, charts, risk review and daily briefs in Codex.

interface.longDescription: Connect a Trading 212 account through a local Keychain-backed MCP server. Review real holdings, Pies, execution markers, technical analysis, backtests, reports and a daily portfolio brief. The plugin has no order execution or account-write capability.
defaultPrompt: Verify my Pies against real positions
